points: Nothing vs Samsung became its own topic
Service network matters more than specs in smaller towns
answer.text: There's no single winner: Pixel's 'a' series for camera and long software updates, Samsung's A-series for display, and Nothing Phone for clean software and design. One practical tip got a lot of agreement: check for a service centre in your town before buying.

desc: Looking for the best all-rounder: camera, battery and at least 4 years of updates.
title: Best phone under ₹50,000
